text:
I love when Taylor Swift starts plotting—because nothing she does feels accidental. In just the past few days, Swift has been everywhere: stepping out with fiancé Travis Kelce, dropping a new song for Disney’s "Toy Story 5," and now? Showing up at Madison Square Garden for what ended up being an unreal win for the Knicks.

For Game 4 of the NBA Finals, and ultimately the greatest comeback in NBA Finals history, the courtside celebrities included Swift, who wore a simple-but-genius blue Knicks T-shirt with two words across the front: Stevie Knicks. With two Haim sisters beside her in matching punny tees, the internet immediately did what it does best—spiral.

The now-viral shirt perfectly blends Swift’s Knicks fandom with a nod to Fleetwood Mac icon Stevie Nicks, creating a crossover moment fans can’t get enough of.

The design itself is simple: bold, vintage-style lettering in classic Knicks blue and orange. It’s the kind of graphic tee that works just as well for game day as it does for a casual, Swiftie-coded outfit. I found one version you can buy online, and you don't want to let this one sit in your cart for long.

You can shop similar versions of the shirt on Etsy and other online retailers, often priced around $20–$40 depending on style and fabric.

The pop star's graphic T-shirt blends the name Stevie Nicks with the New York Knicks, effortlessly combining music and basketball fandom into one viral design. The shirt is a nod to both her Knicks fandom and her longtime admiration for Stevie Nicks, who has influenced her music career for years.

Swift has had a busy week, attending the "Toy Story 5" movie premiere and releasing a new original song, “I Knew It, I Knew You,” for the film’s soundtrack.

Reports and rumors have suggested Madison Square Garden could be a potential venue for Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce, though nothing has been officially confirmed.

Game 5 between the New York Knicks and San Antonio Spurs is scheduled for Saturday, June 13 at 8:30 p.m. ET. The series heads back to San Antonio for the next matchup after New York’s Game 4 win.

As of publication, ticket price start at $2,325.

If you'd like to get a closer view of the Game 5 action, lower level seating starts at $6,754 in Section 26.

Knicks vs. Spurs Game 5 will air on ABC, and it can also be streamed through the ESPN App. All games in the 2026 NBA Finals are scheduled to tip off at 8:30 p.m. ET.
